text: LexisNexis offers Lexis, a premier online legal research platform providing comprehensive legal case law research with relevant results from trusted sources. The platform boasts the largest collection of primary law in the industry, including case law, statutes, regulations, news sources, public records, and company profiles. Lexis integrates tools to explore multiple content types (cases, codes, dockets) within a single platform. A key feature is Ravel View, a data visualization technology offering insights and revealing connections within search results. Lexis also provides exclusive access to Shepard's citation service with comprehensive editorial analysis and positive support.
